def lcf_graph(n, shifts, repeat):
    """Generate graph from LCF notation"""
    edges = set()
    # First create a cycle
    for i in range(n):
        u, v = i, (i+1) % n
        if u > v:
            u, v = v, u
        edges.add((u, v))
    
    # Add chords based on shifts
    shift_list = shifts * repeat
    for i in range(n):
        shift = shift_list[i % len(shift_list)]
        j = (i + shift) % n
        u, v = min(i,j), max(i,j)
        edges.add((u, v))
    
    return list(edges)

def is_k_colorable(G, k):
    nodes = list(G.nodes())
    colors = {}
    
    def backtrack(idx):
        if idx == len(nodes):
            return True
        node = nodes[idx]
        neighbor_colors = {colors[n] for n in G.neighbors(node) if n in colors}
        for c in range(k):
            if c not in neighbor_colors:
                colors[node] = c
                if backtrack(idx + 1):
                    return True
                del colors[node]
        return False
    
    if backtrack(0):

    return False, None
